comments.body:
My knee-jerk reaction would be to suggest upgrading [`NixOS/nixpkgs` -- `pkgs/by-name/as/asciinema/package.nix`](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/18dc8a95fb9d1378d66e52d67c35e0fad509c58e/pkgs/by-name/as/asciinema/package.nix) to version 3+

... Though that might break stuff for folks already using `asciinema` and self managing configs without Home Manager :-\

Alternatively we could support both and have a version check via something like `let version_main = lib.lists.last (builtins.match "(([[:alnum:]]+).*)" package.version) in`

... If that be the preferred route, then `asciinema` config by version links are currently at;
- [v2](https://docs.asciinema.org/manual/cli/configuration/v2/)
- [v3](https://docs.asciinema.org/manual/cli/configuration/v3/)

Quick skim on my end shows some of the blocks got renamed, as well as key names, and a few values transitioned from `yes`/`no` to `true`/`false`, plus string-like values went from no extra quotes to explicit quotes...
Hmm, problem space is finite, but may still result in less-than eloquent code here to handle config version differences

I think the best would be to have `programs.asciinema` be for version `2.4.0` and adding a `programs.asciinema_3` for version `3+` as that's how the versions are named in the `nixpkgs 25.11`

otherwise having `programs.asciinema.settings` be for version `2.4.0` in the stable repository as this is the version installed with `programs.asciinema.enable` and having version `3+` in the unstable and ready to become stable with the `nixpkgs 26.5`
